summary: Repo-local planning already defines source-policy gates, fixture-only source-cache dry-runs, and Track B handoff requirements for an Internet Archive metadata connector, but no live IA access is approved.

references.summary: Records that the Internet Archive metadata connector still needs source policy, User-Agent/contact, rate limits, cache TTL, and kill switch approval before any external call.

Defines the required approval checklist for future live source access: allowlist, User-Agent/contact, rate limits, timeout, retry budget, cache TTL, kill switch, review gates, fixture replay, and audit.
States that current source-cache dry-runs use repo-local synthetic files only and forbid live source calls, connector runtime, source-cache writes, evidence writes, and index mutation.
Notes that IA connector approval must decide source policy, User-Agent/contact posture, rate limits, cache TTL, and kill switch before external calls.
Keeps source registry posture fixture-only and does not approve live IA API calls, scraping, or crawling.
Contains assertions that existing real-source coverage does not make live Internet Archive API calls.

recommended_policy_basis: Approve a metadata-only local pilot policy with runtime disabled, require IA-01 fixture replay before IA-02 live probe approval, and keep IA metadata as source observation material only.
